_note: Space-to-Earth card data. NASA spacecraft fire research that produced Earth technologies. Each links to a NASA source and (where applicable) the related PSI investigation(s).

applications.title: Fine water-mist fire extinguishers
applications.space: Low-mass, low-water fire suppression studied for the ISS, where every kilogram and every drop counts.
applications.earth: Informed efficient fine-water-mist extinguishers that put out fires with far less water than traditional systems.
applications.source: NASA ISS fire-safety research (FLEX suppression lineage); NASA Space Apps challenge brief

applications.title: Smoke-vs-dust fire detector
applications.space: A 1970s Shuttle smoke detector designed to tell real smoke apart from harmless dust.
applications.earth: Fewer nuisance alarms; adopted in industrial settings such as mining operations.

applications.title: Firefighter air tanks
applications.earth: Lighter, higher-capacity air tanks and breathing gear for firefighters.

applications.title: Firefighter protective clothing
applications.space: 1980s application of NASA spacesuit material technology.
applications.earth: More protective, heat-resistant firefighter turnout gear.
applications.source: NASA Spinoff: New Technology for the Fire Attire
